name: P06 door enter every room (talk or walk-in)

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const out=[];for(const D of window.__rooms){__DQ.teleport('meadow',0,0);await sleep(900);for(let i=0;i<15&&__DQ.state().map.id!=='meadow';i++)await sleep(200);const d=window.__doors[D.plot];const standX=d.x+(d.nx?d.nx*-0.35:0);const standZ=d.z+(d.nz?d.nz*-0.35:0);__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',standX,standZ);for(let i=0;i<25&&__DQ.state().map.id!=='puddlewick'&&__DQ.state().map.id!==D.room;i++)await sleep(200);await sleep(500);let map=__DQ.state().map.id;if(map===D.room){out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,went:map,ok:true,how:'walk-in'});continue;}if(map!=='puddlewick'){out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,err:'stuck on '+map,ok:false});continue;}const w=Field.world();const door=w.map.props.find(p=>p.type==='door'&&Math.hypot(p.x-d.x,p.z-d.z)<1.5);if(!door){out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,err:'no door prop',map,doors:w.map.props.filter(p=>p.type==='door').map(p=>p.name),ok:false});continue;}door.talk({field:Field});for(let i=0;i<30&&__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick';i++)await sleep(200);await sleep(400);map=__DQ.state().map.id;out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,went:map,ok:map===D.room,how:'talk'});}window.__TALK=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()
